subject: Quick note on the schedule
text: Sorry this is coming fast, but the community center moved the orientation slot, so if you had planned to bring paperwork next Tuesday, bring it tomorrow instead because the volunteer desk closes at noon and someone needs to stamp the forms before the first session. My honest advice is not to wait until the last minute, even if the email said “bring when convenient,” because the staff will be juggling three groups in the hallway and only one person is checking envelopes. If you cannot come tomorrow morning, send me a short note by tonight so I can see whether there is a second drop-off window on Wednesday, though that depends on whether the new schedule stays in place. Also, if you already attached the housing verification in the online portal, skip printing it; the printed copy is easier for the intake folder, but the digital file has been visible since yesterday. I know this is confusing, and I wish we had heard sooner, but do not stress too much. If your bus is delayed, a text is enough, but a quick call is safer if you are close. The main thing is to let the front desk know you are still coming, because an unclaimed file can be pushed to the next batch, and that will cost you a week rather than just an hour.
